text: Every smile below started with a conversation, a full examination, and a plan built around that specific patient. No shortcuts. No assumptions.
From the moment you walk in, Arvada Dental feels different. Calm, modern, and built with patients in mind - because your experience starts before you sit in the chair.

This is a real Arvada Dental patient. She called us after two nights without sleep, with a cracked molar that had abscessed, having been told the earliest opening elsewhere was ten days away. Drag the slider to see where he finished.
Painkillers every four hours, barely touching it
Swelling starting to spread along the jaw
Sent home from urgent care with antibiotics only
Told the next opening was ten days away
Seen the same afternoon he called
Out of pain before he left the chair
A written plan for the permanent repair
“I could not think about anything else.”
Dental pain does not wait for a convenient appointment. It escalates overnight, it stops you sleeping, and by morning you are calling anyone who will pick up the phone.
“Someone actually answered, and got me in.”
Tell our team what is happening. We triage over the phone, tell you honestly whether you need to be seen today, and hold you a slot if you do.
“The pain stopped before I left the chair.”
A focused exam and X-ray find the cause, then we treat the pain and any infection first with IV sedation available if anxiety is part of what kept you waiting.
“For once, nobody rushed me into anything.”
Once you are comfortable, you get a written plan and fee for the permanent repair a filling, a crown, a root canal, an extraction, or an implant. You decide when, not in the middle of a crisis.

faq.q: What counts as a dental emergency in Arvada, Colorado?
faq.a: Any situation involving severe pain, a knocked-out or broken tooth, a dental abscess, significant swelling, or a lost restoration that is causing discomfort qualifies as a dental emergency. When in doubt, call us and we will help you determine the best next step.

faq.q: How quickly can I be seen for a dental emergency in Arvada, Colorado?
faq.a: We do our best to see emergency patients the same day they call. Call (719) 631-5419 as early as possible and let us know what you are experiencing so we can prepare for your arrival.

faq.q: What should I do if my tooth gets knocked out?
faq.a: Rinse the tooth gently without scrubbing, try to reinsert it in the socket, or keep it moist in milk. Call us immediately. Time is critical, the sooner you arrive, the better the chance of saving the tooth

faq.q: What should I do for tooth pain before I can be seen?
faq.a: Take an over-the-counter pain reliever like ibuprofen and apply a cold compress to the outside of your cheek. Do not place aspirin directly on the gum.

faq.q: Does dental insurance cover emergency visits in Arvada, Colorado?
faq.a: Most dental insurance plans cover at least a portion of emergency exams and necessary treatment. Our team will review your benefits when you call and help you understand what is covered. We also offer financing options for any out-of-pocket costs.

faq.q: Do you treat dental emergencies for children in Arvada, Colorado?
faq.a: Yes. We treat patients of all ages, including children. If your child has a dental emergency, call us right away and we will get them in as quickly as possible.
